property_summary: For any non-empty list of recipient addresses with matching values, C.transfer returns true and leaves Ether balances unchanged, provided the target token address does not revert.
When the token address never reverts, C.transfer with a single recipient returns true without changing Ether balances.
C.transfer reverts whenever the recipient list is empty, regardless of other inputs.

For any non-empty recipient list, C.transfer returns true even if the token call fails, because _s is only a call-success flag — but if the token call reverts the low-level call returns false and transfer reverts; the rule: transfer returns true whenever the token call does not revert.
For any non-empty recipient list whose lengths match, C.transfer returns true whenever the token address contains no code (so the low-level calls succeed), without requiring Ether.
C.transfer reverts when the recipient list is empty and, for any non-empty list with matching-length arrays, returns true without altering C's own Ether balance.
